jobs.title: Armed Patrol Driver: Retail Security & Quick Response
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Haslet, TX is seeking a Security Officer Armed Patrol Driver for full-time work. Pay: $25.00 per hour; Schedule: Mon–Fri with shifts as listed.

You will provide customer service, respond to incidents (including armed situations as needed), conduct patrols, monitor access, and coordinate with site leadership and emergency responders. Requirements include Level III Armed Certification in Texas, a valid driver’s license, HS diploma, and background/drug screening.

jobs.title: Part-Time Retail Security & Patrol Specialist
jobs.description:
Allied Universal® is seeking a Security Officer Experienced Patrol Associate in Arlington, TX for a part-time role. You will provide customer service, perform security procedures at a retail location, and respond to incidents while staying calm and reporting details per site protocols.

You will conduct patrols, monitor entrances and high‑traffic areas, and document incidents while communicating with site contacts and leadership to ensure security quality and safety.
